name: Combined Arms
strategy: Coordinate different battlefield roles to improve the performance of ordinary troops, specialists, and supporting formations.

commands.name: Screen and Advance
commands.effect: Choose one friendly Unit within 2" of a different friendly Unit. It gains +2" Move on its next normal Move this Round. This bonus cannot be used for a Charge.

commands.name: Crossfire
commands.effect: The active Unit gains Accurate 2 and Pinpoint on its next ranged Attack this Assault Phase against an enemy already attacked by a different friendly Unit this Round.

commands.name: Coordinated Orders
commands.effect: Choose two different friendly Units within Short of the same friendly Headquarters. Remove one temporary Hit or Move penalty from one. The other gains Accurate 1 on its next Attack this Round.

commands.name: Interlocking Lines
commands.effect: When a friendly Unit within 2" of a different friendly Unit is attacked in Engagement, the defender gains Tough 2 against that Attack.

commands.name: Forward Observers
commands.effect: The active Unit gains Accurate 1 and ignores Cover against its next ranged Attack this Phase, provided a different friendly Unit can see the target. Cover granted by any source is ignored for this Attack.

doctrineIdentity: Cooperation between multiple Units. Combined Arms rewards keeping formations close enough to support each other without requiring specific recruitment categories.
knownIssues: Shares its name with the Free Realms Faction Rule, which has an unrelated effect (Accurate 1 vs. an already-Engaged enemy). See rules_data_json/doctrines/00_general_rules.json.
